services.introTitle: Build the house you will grow old in.

stories.contracting: Crews who have raised hundreds of homes across Tripoli, Benghazi and Misrata. One contract covers the frame, the finishes and the handover.
stories.design3d: Walk through every room before a single block is laid. Move a wall, a window or a floor finish while it still costs nothing.
stories.poolsLandscape: A pool sized for the family, shade where the afternoon sun lands, and an irrigation plan that survives August.
stories.solarWater: Panels on the roof, a tank that stays full and hot water without the generator, sized from your actual bills.
stories.smartHome: Cameras you can check from anywhere, doors that open for the right people, and lights that know when you are home.
stories.maintenance: When a pipe bursts or the AC quits in July, a vetted technician can be at your door the same day.

bourse.title: Materials bourse
bourse.subtitle: Reference prices from suppliers in Tripoli, Benghazi and Misrata, updated live. Delivery not included.

calc.title: Smart cost calculator
calc.subtitle: Multiplies typical consumption per m² by the live bourse prices above.
calc.disclaimer: An early estimate for budgeting only. Get a contractor quote for a binding price.

footer.about: AQAR brings property listings, construction trades and live material prices together for homeowners across Libya.
